title: theme-modes module
description: Maintaining the optional light/dark theme modes core module and dual-palette theme editor.

blocks.text: theme-modes lives under packages/core/modules/theme-modes/ and is registered in packages/core/modules.json with feature flag themeModes. Core theme infrastructure (lib/theme/patch-files.ts, ThemeEditor, /api/theme) supports dual palettes when SITE.features.themeModes is true.

rows: Reads/writes light + dark CSS blocks and site.ts colorsDark

blocks.text: scripts/module-installer-core.mjs applyThemeModesInstall() runs on theme-modes install: site.ts patch, globals.css dark block, layout ThemeModeInit wiring.

blocks.code:
pnpm template:add-module hotel theme-modes
pnpm template:add-module dev-agency theme-modes

blocks.text: Shipped vertical templates do not enable theme-modes by default. Document optional add-ons on each template docs page. templates.json may list optionalModuleExamples for CLI info output.
